title: Freeform GenAI-assisted mobile application development task
summary: Final-year degree-apprenticeship students independently design and build an ambitious Flutter mobile application over seven weeks. GenAI may be used freely during development, but generated code must be cited and students must explain their product and understanding in a viva and reflection.

sources.title: Learning without Limits: Analysing the Usage of Generative AI in a Summative Assessment
sources.evidence_quote: Learners were instructed beforehand that they may use it as they wish, and were given particular rules on how to cite generated code.

context.discipline: software engineering and mobile application development

assessment.summary: Develop a self-selected mobile application in Dart and Flutter, submit the product, disclose GenAI use, and defend understanding in a viva.
student_actions: Design and incrementally develop a mobile application.
Choose whether and how much GenAI to use.
Complete a self-reflection on what GenAI was used, when, why, and how.
Defend the completed application in a viva.

student_role.description: Students may use any available GenAI tools as much or as little as they wish during development.

grading.method: Students were marked on the end product and understanding demonstrated in the viva, not on the written code itself.

reported_results: All 13 learners used GenAI to some extent.
More than 80% described GenAI inclusion as a positive learning experience.
